Prompts are the independent unit; the two draws of a prompt are correlated.

runtime.paper_guidance: Report runtime medians from a --timing-only run on an otherwise idle machine; medians from a parallel run are an upper bound.
runtime.unit: wall seconds of one single-threaded detection call (perf_counter)
